name: ksrc-native
description: Search and read Kotlin/Native platform API signatures (platform.UIKit, platform.Foundation), the native stdlib sources and Xcode SDK headers. Needs the ksrc-native binary on PATH.

interface.shortDescription: Look up Kotlin/Native platform APIs, the native stdlib and Xcode SDK headers
interface.longDescription: A skill that teaches the agent to run the ksrc-native command: search a Kotlin/Native platform library, the native stdlib sources or the Objective-C headers of an Xcode SDK, then read the file a hit points at. The ksrc-native binary must be on PATH.
defaultPrompt: Show the Kotlin signature of UIApplication.openURL with ksrc-native.
